card.name: Drug exposure and level nouns
card.fires_on: Nouns for how much drug is in the body, mainly "exposure", also "curve" in "area under the curve" and "distributions" after "dose". Seen after words like decreased, increased or the in interaction text.

modes.label: Exposure after change word
modes.description: The word "exposure" right after decreased, increased or the, in drug interaction statements.
modes.example: Decreased<< exposure>> of some antiretroviral drugs

modes.label: Area under the curve
modes.description: The word "curve" ending the phrase "area under the curve" in pharmacokinetic comparisons.
modes.example: at maternal area under the<< curve>> (AUCs) approximately 2

modes.label: Dose distributions
modes.description: A plural measurement noun following "radiation dose" in dosimetry text.
modes.example: The biokinetic modeling and radiation dose<< distributions>> associated with thyroid uptake of iodide I
